# Colitis Gourmet Planner 1.0.0 beta

Colitis Gourmet Planner 1.0.0 public Android beta.

Local-first meal planner, shopping lists and preferences. Public NHS and Crohn's & Colitis UK resource links. No Colitis cloud account or sync. Feedback is saved on your own device only, not sent to developers. The app needs an internet connection to load its hosted interface. Clearing app data can erase local information.

Not personalised medical advice or a substitute for your clinical team. This is a public test release and has not been submitted to Google Play. Requires Android to approve installation from an outside source. Tested on an Android phone by the developer; full device/compatibility testing remains open.

### Installation

Download the attached `.apk` release asset. On Android, approve installation from the browser or file manager if prompted. Download only from this official GitHub repository. The file is signed by the existing Expo EAS build credentials.
